samplingFrame.enumerationLimit: OpenDART list pagination provides page and total metadata but no frozen snapshot token; full page traversal is not proof of a point-in-time complete population.
samplingFrame.samplingRule: Owner-approved deterministic random selection within declared strata plus a separately enumerated challenge set; freeze query, seed commitment, selected receipt digests, and disposition denominator before candidate output is reviewed.

strata.basis: Official pblntf_ty and pblntf_detail_ty values; include every in-scope type or retain an explicit OUT_OF_SCOPE disposition.
Candidate scorer outputs including positive, neutral, negative, and no-match.
Correction markers, rm flags, explicit relation, unresolved relation, and no marker.
Single filer, affiliate/counterparty, multiple named parties, and unresolved subject attribution.
Explicit value with denominator/period, partial basis, explicit zero, missing value, and conflicting fields.
Termination/conditions, dilution/financing, litigation/regulatory, negative outcome, and no located counterevidence.
Body available and permitted, unavailable, fetch failed, or action rights blocked; never silently exclude.

samplingFrame.sizePolicy: No numeric sample size or threshold is invented. Owner approval is required before selection; all unreviewed, unavailable, excluded, and rights-blocked records remain in the denominator with disposition.

blindReviewProtocol.reviewers: Two independent qualified reviewers label the frozen evidence before seeing candidate model/scorer output; identities and roles are assigned by owner, not supplied by the candidate system.
blindReviewProtocol.adjudication: Any disagreement on source fact, locator, party role, correction relation, quantitative basis, risk, or publication disposition requires a separately assigned adjudicator; majority vote does not resolve conflicts.
blindReviewProtocol.candidateDisclosure: Candidate output is revealed only after independent labels are frozen; disagreement or candidate leakage invalidates the affected review pass.

evidenceRetention.ifRightsAllowBodyRetention: Store exact source URL/product, receipt, document revision/hash, permitted locator, reviewer label revisions and access scope; body storage remains a separate exact action decision.
evidenceRetention.ifRightsAllowTransientReviewOnly: Use controlled transient review, then retain only permitted metadata, locator/hash if explicitly allowed, decision labels and disposal receipt; do not copy body text into fixtures or logs.
evidenceRetention.ifRightsUnresolvedOrDenied: Do not fetch or inspect body; mark RIGHTS_BLOCKED and NOT_RUN, keep the selected record in denominator, and do not classify content as correct/incorrect.

versionInvalidationTriggers: source terms/product license or field/action scope change
official guide schema, taxonomy or correction semantics change
filing body revision or correction relation changes
instrument master, common-stock eligibility or market-cap policy changes
parser, normalization, taxonomy, prompt, model or output schema changes
reviewer qualification, independence, or adjudication policy changes
sampling frame, denominator, or acceptance threshold changes
